extra.summary: POSB Everyday Card is an all-rounded cash rebates credit card. Enjoy up to 10% cash rebates on your daily essentials when you dine, shop online or purchase groceries. Also enjoy 50% off family attractions and other exclusive deals and up to 20.1% on fuel at SPC.
badges: Earn Cash Rebates that Never Expire

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: Prevailing interest rate of 27.8% p.a. (subject to compounding if the charges are not repaid in full) on the transaction amount, chargeable on a daily basis from the date of transaction until receipt of full payment. (Minimum charge: S$2.50)

our_takes.our-take: The POSB Everyday Card shines for Sheng Siong shoppers, offering 5% cashback with no minimum spend (capped at $30 daily). SPC drivers also benefit from 6% cashback on fuel, plus discounts. While dining and online food delivery earn minimal cashback unless you hit a steep $800 monthly spend, and telco rebates end, this card is best for those focused on groceries and petrol. Consider alternatives if you want broader category rewards beyond these specific merchants.
our_takes.good-for:
For homeowners who frequent Sheng Siong, enjoying upfront cashback with no minimum spend and daily cashback.
Perfect for drivers seeking fuel savings at SPC, automotive services at Speedycare, complemented by shopping and dining rewards.
Families can maximize daily spending with cashback on groceries like Sheng Siong, utilities, and dining, plus telecommunications benefits.
our_takes.things-to-note:
The annual fee of S$196.20 is waived the first year, but consider if rewards justify the cost after.
Interest charges accumulate - at 27.8% p.a., carrying balances can make debt much more expensive over time.
